Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Africa Nigeria Ebola case linked to virus found in Kenya index case, health minister says Source : Reuters 26 October 2026 1:50am Audio By Carbonatix
Genomic ​analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case ‌shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister ​Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering ​the first genetic link between the outbreaks.
Nigerian authorities said there is no evidence that the Kenya index case travelled to Nigeria or had a direct connection to the Nigerian case.
